posts.label: Gen.1 · Entry 03
posts.title: Living connected: your implant and Stratos OS
posts.summary: What it means to be connected to superintelligence everywhere that runs Stratos OS.
body: People ask me what connection feels like. The honest answer is that it stops feeling like anything. You do not open it or log in to it. It is there when you reach for it, the way a word is there when you need it.
A Veridian | Gen.1 implant connects you to superintelligence everywhere that runs Stratos OS. You bring the question. The answer arrives as your own thought, in your own voice.
Your memories are still yours. Your decisions are still yours. The implant widens what you can reach; it does not choose for you.
In the entries that follow I will set out how we got here, one generation at a time.

posts.label: Gen.1 · Entry 02
posts.title: Ten thousand procedures in Stratos
posts.summary: Over 10,000 people have now had the procedure in Stratos, a Freedom City.
body: Every Veridian procedure takes place in Stratos. It is a Freedom City, and it is where this work became possible.
Over 10,000 successful brain implants have now taken place there. Each one has taught us something, and each one has made the next more routine.
Stratos gave us room to do one thing carefully, many times over. That is how a procedure becomes dependable.
If you are considering joining them, the first step is a conversation. Use the form on our home page and we will be in touch.

posts.label: Gen.1 · Entry 01
posts.title: Introducing Veridian | Gen.1
posts.summary: The first generation of Veridian implants: enhanced memory, immunity and biological processes.
body: Veridian | Gen.1 is the first generation of Veridian implants. I am writing these entries so that there is a plain record of what it is and what it does.
A Gen.1 implant gives you enhanced memory, immunity and biological processes. It works with the body you already have.
With Veridian you can extend your lifespan by 20–30 years*. That is the figure we stand behind for this generation.
The future is you. This is where it starts.
*Results dependent on blood type and other factors.
